review_kind: Parallel assistant code review and adversarial probes, followed by regression tests

findings.problem: Returned nested research costs and comparator choices aliased input dictionaries; mutation changed the report without changing its evidence digest.
Finite per-item costs could overflow totals; success serialization outside the handler left an old report in place.
findings.resolution: Validate all derived numbers and serialize inside the bound failure path; retain original input bytes and hash.

findings.problem: Candidate evaluation could precede construction and still be conditionally Adoptable.
findings.resolution: Bind construction output/evaluation input to the candidate manifest and enforce causal job order.

findings.problem: Terminal evaluator work had no ledger job; reported subtotal could be mistaken for complete cost.
findings.resolution: Require separate terminal metering and mark missing/unreconciled coverage unknown; total remains null.

findings.problem: Training/search with a null candidate escaped the finite candidate inventory.
findings.resolution: Require all training/search jobs to belong to a registered candidate.

findings.problem: A next-task declaration could reuse the source owner checkpoint.
findings.resolution: Require a distinct declared new checkpoint; native verification remains separate.

findings.problem: The terminal meter could reference the signed terminal artifact through its artifact digest, creating a cycle.
findings.resolution: The terminal meter must have null artifact digest and a separate meter receipt.

disposition: All listed findings have final-source regression coverage; 176 local integrated tests passed with no skips.
scope: This review qualifies software contracts only. It does not establish real-model efficacy, source independence, native receipts or incumbent next-task use.
